name: Grand Mercure Jakarta Harmoni
short_description: A 483-room hotel on Jalan Hayam Wuruk billed as the first upscale international hotel blending French hospitality with Indonesian tradition, near Gajah Mada Plaza.
ai_summary: Grand Mercure Jakarta Harmoni sits on Jalan Hayam Wuruk in Central Jakarta, about a 5-minute walk from Gajah Mada Plaza and roughly 30 minutes from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport. Marketed as the first upscale international hotel blending French hospitality with Indonesian tradition, the 483-room property serves an Indonesian herbal jamu drink alongside its breakfast buffet and offers an outdoor pool, poolside bar, sauna, and spa tub. Guests consistently praise the central location, spacious rooms, and friendly, fast front-desk service, though some reviews note ongoing MRT construction traffic nearby and maintenance issues -- including a few reports of unclean fixtures or non-working amenities -- in a subset of stays.

faqs.question: Is Grand Mercure Jakarta Harmoni close to shopping?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's about a 5-minute walk from Gajah Mada Plaza, and its Hayam Wuruk location in Central Jakarta puts it within reach of the historic Kota Tua area as well.

faqs.question: Does Grand Mercure Jakarta Harmoni have any local touches?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the breakfast buffet includes traditional Indonesian jamu herbal drink alongside local and international dishes, reflecting the hotel's positioning as a blend of French hospitality and Indonesian tradition.
